resources.string: How the list of stocks looks · the background and theme stay
Space Glass background now: compact table
One slim line a stock · tap it to open the full detail in place
Tiles in two columns: score dial, 15-day line and price
Figures in small capsules · swipe left for ★ Watchlist and Chart
%1$s: swipe left for the Watchlist and Chart buttons

Pick how the list looks in Menu → Layout. \"The background\'s own\" keeps the big cards on Galaxy and the compact table on Space Glass. Accordion makes each stock one slim line; tap it and the score bar, MCap, Volume, RVOL, R/S and support open in place, with Alert, Chart and Details buttons. Bento grid lays out tiles in two columns: a round score dial, the last 15 days\' line, the price and the 5-day change; long-press a tile to add it to the watchlist. Swipe cards put the figures in small capsules, and dragging a card to the left shows the ★ Watchlist and Chart buttons.
